results.title: Ebola: Anambra deploys surveillance officers to strategic locations
results.description: By Vincent Ujumadu AWKA — The Anambra State Government has announced plans to deploy health surveillance officers to strategic locations, including the Chinua Achebe International Airport, Umueri, motor parks, banks and other public gathering places, following the reported confirmation of an Ebola case in Abuja.
